A two-panel figure with a sub-caption layout, a single figure, and a figure with no dark twin.

```{r}
#| label: fig-two
#| fig-cap: "Two panels."
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - "First"
#|   - "Second"
#| layout-nrow: 2
#| out.width: "50%"

knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "tests/fixtures/figure-pair/a-light.svg",
  "tests/fixtures/figure-pair/b-light.svg"
))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-one
#| fig-cap: "One panel."

knitr::include_graphics("tests/fixtures/figure-pair/a-light.svg")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-lone
#| fig-cap: "No twin."

knitr::include_graphics("tests/fixtures/figure-pair/lone-light.svg")
```

See @fig-two, @fig-one and @fig-lone.
